back.notes:
wǒ kàn le shū

了 indicates a completed action, marking that the action of reading the book is finished.

front.text: 我很高興能和你一起唱歌。

back.text: I am very glad to be able to sing with you.
back.notes:
Wǒ hěn gāoxìng néng hé nǐ yīqǐ chànggē.

唱歌 (chànggē) - to sing (songs)

back.text: shuì jiào - to sleep; go to bed

back.notes:
tiānqì hěn hǎo

好 is an adjective meaning 'good', describing the weather.

back.text: I would like to go to Beijing.
back.notes:
wǒ xiǎng qù běi jīng

想 is a verb meaning ``to think'' or ``would like to'', here expressing desire.

zhè shì wǒ de shū

的 indicates possession, linking '我' (I) to '書' (book), meaning 'my'.

tā xiànzài zài xuéxí

在 indicates an action in progress, showing that the subject is currently studying.

zhè běn shū hěn hǎo

很 is an adverb meaning ``very'', modifying the adjective 好.

front.text: 王先生今天穿了一件白色的衣服。

back.text: Mr. Wang is wearing a white piece of clothing today.
back.notes:
Wáng xiānsheng jīntiān chuānle yī jiàn báisè de yīfu.

白 (bái) - white; appears in 白色 (white-colored)

front.text: 請你把這本書放在桌子上吧。

back.text: Please put this book on the table.
back.notes:
Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhè běn shū fàng zài zhuōzi shàng ba.

吧 (ba) - modal particle used to make a polite suggestion

back.text: My older sister is taller than me.
back.notes:
Wǒ jiějie bǐ wǒ gāo.

比 (bǐ) - than; used in comparisons

wǒ jīntiān qù xuéxiào

我 is the first-person singular pronoun meaning 'I'.

back.text: le - indicates a completed or finished action

front.text: 媽媽說別在桌子上寫字。

back.text: Mother says don't write on the table.
back.notes:
Māmā shuō bié zài zhuōzi shàng xiě zì.

別 (bié) - don't; prohibitive adverb

tā shì lǎo shī

她 is a third‑person feminine pronoun meaning ``she'', used as the subject.
